title: NRC20
tagline: NRC20 is a unique Dex that makes NFTs tradable as ERC20 tokens.
description: NRC20 is a unique Dex that makes NFTs tradable as ERC20 tokens. People can put liquidity in the liquidity pools and swap NFTs for tokens and vice versa. It's a unique approach to how ERC20 are traded on Dexes at the moment. It used the cross product method to calculate the LP share and the price per NFT.
how_its_made: I've deployed it on Filecoin testnet. I've used rainbowkit for wallet connect and react from frontend. Used hardhat for contract development. I've used etherjs to interact with the smart contract. The smart contract are developed in solidity language.  The whole implementation was tricky but was worth the efforts at the end.
